statement: Binding non-goals: no new execution control plane or takeover runner; no Vuoro ownership of code, intent, evidence or acceptance; no centralized evidence ownership in auditctl (repo shards stay authoritative, auditctl owns the envelope); no federation schema on speculation; no scribedispatch integration; no W7; no hostproto-semantics merge into hostproto; no pre-emptive enablement of repositories without a consumer; no renovation of guidance-only manifests.
